course_position.stage_name: Solid B1+ to Low B2 Development

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Use reference words to keep a complaint or support case coherent.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Explaining a delivery, bill, or account issue without repeating the same noun in every sentence.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Referring back to a problem, case, message, or solution clearly.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik prepare a short support message about a delayed delivery and refer back to the case details.

main_focus.name: reference language with det, den, ärendet, and problemet
main_focus.description: Use clear reference words and nouns to connect sentences and avoid repetitive complaint language.
model_examples: Det gäller en leverans som skulle komma i fredags.
Ärendet är fortfarande öppet, men problemet är inte löst.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use reference words or case nouns 5-7 times, making sure each reference is unambiguous.

allowed_supporting_grammar: relative clauses with som for identifying the item
perfect and preteritum for status and events
connectors such as däremot and därför
passive forms for service status if natural
avoid_grammar: advanced relative pronouns such as vars as a main target

useful_chunks: Kan ni återkomma med en lösning?
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use reference chunks to make the support message clear and cohesive.

dialogue_shape.opening: A delivery or support case is introduced with a few important details.
dialogue_shape.middle: They practice referring back to the case, the item, and the problem without creating confusion.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree on a concise message asking for an update or solution.

target_complexity.repetition: Relative clauses may appear only to identify the delivery or message; reference coherence is the main point.

focus: the problem that the support case concerns
the status of the case or delivery
the update or solution being requested

sentence_focus: one sentence beginning with det gäller
one sentence with ärendet är fortfarande
one sentence identifying an item with som
one sentence with problemet är att
one sentence requesting a solution or update
